subject.title: fix: reconcile timed-out gateway message actions

question: Should timed-out message-action reconciliation prevent duplicate delivery only while the current Gateway process survives, or must the guarantee also survive Gateway restart?
rationale: Current main provides only process-local in-flight joins and a five-minute process-local result cache; restart-safe reconciliation requires a materially different persisted operation or receipt contract.

options.title: Accept process-local reconciliation
options.body: Merge after real transport and channel proof, with restart during the ambiguity window explicitly outside the guarantee.

options.title: Require restart-safe reconciliation
options.body: Persist operation identity and terminal results before accepting the automatic reconnect behavior.

options.title: Pause the retry approach
options.body: Leave current timeout behavior unchanged until maintainers settle the required delivery guarantee.

recommendation.title: Accept process-local reconciliation
recommendation.body: Merge after real transport and channel proof, with restart during the ambiguity window explicitly outside the guarantee.

likelyOwner.reason: His dominant history across the exact gateway and outbound files makes him the strongest available owner for this delivery-guarantee boundary.
